message:
feat: implement metadata migration and ref-based commit retrieval

WHY
Metadata stored in legacy directories was lost during restructuring, and commit history was difficult to track accurately after squash merges or when relying solely on the CommitStore.

WHAT
* Added migration logic to move and deduplicate branch metadata from .git-courer/branches to the new metadata directory.
* Implemented commitsFromRefs to extract commit history directly from git refs/courer/* blobs.
* Updated release workflow to prioritize git refs for commit retrieval before falling back to the local store.
* Added logic to cleanup refs/courer/* after successful release.
* Fixed CatFile to fallback to git show when path is empty.
* Added logic to handle empty commit hash in UpdateRef by executing git update-ref -d.
* Configured remote origin fetch refspec on init to track courer-specific references.
author: Alejandro
